title.zh: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
title.en: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device

current_state.zh: Ledger announced Atom, a touchscreen Android signing device with a Ledger OS Secure Element, which will ship with Solana Mobile's Seeker app and dApp Store preinstalled as part of a new hardware partnership.
current_state.en: Ledger announced Atom, a touchscreen Android signing device with a Ledger OS Secure Element, which will ship with Solana Mobile's Seeker app and dApp Store preinstalled as part of a new hardware partnership.
